description: This file contains unit tests for the GlobalLocaleList class, specifically testing the behavior of global property change handling related to allowed locale settings.

classes.name: GlobalLocaleListTest
classes.description: Test class for the GlobalLocaleList class, verifying its behavior when global properties related to locale allowed lists change.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the GlobalLocaleList instance before each test.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged_shouldSetAllowedLocalesIfGlobalPropertyIsAnEmptyString
methods.description: Tests if allowed locales are correctly set to Locale.ROOT when the global property is an empty string.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged_shouldSetAllowedLocalesIfGlobalPropertyContainsTwoLocales
methods.description: Tests if allowed locales are correctly parsed and set when the global property contains multiple locale codes.
